body.x: PERI(www.myperi.com), an innovative brand set on defining the way consumers view hi-definition audio and mobile power accessories, unveiled the PERI Duo at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.The PERI Duo is a first-of-its kind case that integrates a high-definition, high-power speaker system and 2500mAh battery. Creating a full audio experience loud enough to fill any room, the PERI Duo also provides more than a full charge to your smartphone, all in a sleek design, making it perfect for everyday use in casual and professional settings.It functions as a stand-alone Bluetooth or wi-fi portable speaker, and can be attached with an iPhone as a case for on-the-go listening and added charge. With an integrated hi-res DAC (digital-to-analog converter) and fully programmable single-chip audio DSP, it offers true equalization settings through the embedded DSP firmware using the PERI Audio App.It can also be configured to multicast music with multiple PERI Duo cases through peer-to-peer wi-fi connectivity, creating a custom audio experience. It is suitable for playing in surround sound mode, conference calling, party mode and creating other amazing sound experiences.It contains a 2500mAh battery inside so that users can receive an additional 130-160 percent battery, which gives about 12-17 hours of talk time or 4-6 hours of continuous playback depending on volume setting.
